# AChat — Documentation Index

> AChat is a messaging app for personal chats, groups, communities, status and anonymous rooms, in the browser and on Android, in English, Spanish, French, German and Arabic. Accounts use Google sign-in and a username; no phone number is asked for. Anonymous rooms need no account: a display name and a link. Personal chats, private groups and their files are end-to-end encrypted, and a room with a password encrypts its messages on the device; communities, their channels, open rooms and status updates are not end-to-end encrypted. Linked devices and a user-held recovery key restore history; AChat keeps no copy of message keys. Anonymous room messages are kept for a set number of days (10 by default) unless someone keeps the room. Plans: Free, Pro and Team / Family. AChat does not make voice or video calls. Web app: https://achat.aoneahsan.com. Built by the AChat team.

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/intro): what AChat does and what it doesn't promise.
- [Installation & access](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/installation): web and Android; anonymous or with an account.
- [Quick Start](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/quick-start): the first chat, with a contact or in an anonymous room.

## Features

- [Personal chats & contacts](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/personal-chats-and-contacts): usernames, invite links, QR codes, requests, blocks, online status, read receipts.
- [Devices & recovery key](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/devices-and-recovery): linking devices, security codes, the recovery key.
- [Anonymous rooms](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/anonymous-chats): room IDs, display names, passwords, how long rooms last.
- [Passwords & encryption](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/passwords-and-encryption): which chats are end-to-end encrypted and the limits.
- [Groups & communities](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/groups-and-communities): encrypted groups; communities with channels, roles, reports and bans.
- [Status](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/status): 24-hour updates for contacts; not end-to-end encrypted.
- [Kept rooms & your account](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/keep-chats-and-accounts): keeping rooms, username, export, account deletion.
- [Threads & replies](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/threads-and-replies): replies and threads.
- [Files, voice notes & media](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/file-sharing): plan-based file allowances, voice notes, video.
- [Manage messages](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/manage-messages): edit, forward, Trash, clear, disappearing messages, view once, polls, archive.
- [Writing messages](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/writing-messages): drafts, spoilers, maths, mentions, stickers, dictation, translation, read aloud.
- [Search & offline history](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/search-and-history): on-device search and the offline outbox.
- [Embeddable widget](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/embeddable-widget): rooms and channels on other websites, with allowed websites.
- [Notifications & email](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/notifications-and-email): opt-in notifications without message text; account emails.
- [Appearance, language & shortcuts](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/themes-and-accessibility): the Appearance panel, five languages, keyboard shortcuts.
- [Privacy on this device](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/privacy-on-this-device): privacy screen, neutral tab, clipboard clearing, Wipe from this device.
- [Device & location history](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/location-history): what some chats record, who sees it, consent.
- [Plans & pricing](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/plans-and-pricing): Free, Pro, Team / Family, payment and referrals.

## White-label & licensing

- [White-label & licensing](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label): run AChat under your own name, hosted by the AChat team, or buy its source code outright, for the buyout price plus a 7% royalty on its gross revenue (excluding sales tax/VAT), paid quarterly with a revenue statement for as long as it earns, including after a resale.
- [What you get per platform](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/what-is-delivered): the web app and the mobile app (Android, iOS on request).
- [Setting up your copy](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/setup): licence email, domain, name, logo and colours.
- [Updates and renewals](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/updates-and-renewals): six months included, renewals, running without one.
- [Verify a licence](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/verify-a-licence): checking a copy by key or by domain.
- [White-label questions](https://achat-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/faq): source code, exclusivity, the buyout royalty, paying by Wise transfer, custom work, iOS.
- Prices: https://achat.aoneahsan.com/white-label/pricing (licence) and https://achat.aoneahsan.com/white-label/buyout (buyout).
